title: Auditors Struggle to Catch Sabotage In End-to-End Transcripts of AI Safety Research
abstract: arXiv:2611.21832v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As AI systems are increasingly used to automate AI R&D, misaligned systems could sabotage research intended to improve model safety and alignment. To stress-test defenses against such sabotage, we use a human expert as a proxy saboteur on AI safety research. We conduct a red-team/blue-team game where a human researcher runs AI safety experiments from scratch and auditors try to tell which were sabotaged and how. Given access to the full research transcript and the ability to run experiments, human auditors mostly fail to distinguish sabotaged from benign research: they achieve an AUROC of 0.59, not significantly better than chance, and fully identify the specific sabotage in only 17% of cases. Despite not being allowed to run experiments, the best frontier models outperform human auditors (Fable 5.1: AUROC 0.73, 32% full identification) within noise and weaker models perform comparably. translated_title: 审计员难以在AI安全研究的端到端全程转录记录中发现破坏行为
translated_abstract: 随着AI系统被越来越多地用于自动化AI研发，未对齐的系统可能会破坏那些旨在提升模型安全性与对齐性的研究。为了对防御此类破坏的手段进行压力测试，我们让一名人类专家充当“代理破坏者”对AI安全研究实施破坏。我们开展了一场红队/蓝队博弈：一名人类研究员从零开始进行AI安全实验，而审计员则需要判断哪些实验遭到了破坏以及破坏是如何实施的。即便审计员可以访问完整的研究全程转录记录并有能力亲自运行实验，人类审计员大多仍无法区分被破坏的研究与良性研究：他们仅取得0.59的AUROC，并不显著优于随机水平，且仅在17%的案例中完整识别出具体的破坏方式。尽管不被允许运行实验，最强的前沿模型仍优于人类审计员（Fable 5.1：AUROC 0.73，32%完整识别率），但这一差距在噪声范围之内，而较弱的模型表现则与之相当。当破坏者选择哪些实验会遭到……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过人类专家充当破坏者的红队/蓝队博弈实验，揭示了无论是拥有完整实验权限的人类审计员（AUROC仅0.59、完整识别率仅17%）还是前沿AI模型，都难以从AI安全研究的端到端全程转录记录中检测出破坏行为，表明当前针对AI暗中破坏研发的审计防御存在重大缺口。
en_tdlr: Through a red-team/blue-team game with a human expert as proxy saboteur, this paper shows that both human auditors (AUROC 0.59, only 17% full identification) and frontier AI models struggle to detect sabotage in end-to-end transcripts of AI safety research, revealing a major gap in current auditing defenses against AI sabotage of R&D.
